parameter.name: item
parameter.label: Price Item
parameter.description: The item carrying the raw future price series, as a binding publishes it. Nothing is read until this is set.

parameter.name: persistenceService
parameter.label: Persistence Service
parameter.description: Which persistence service holds the item's future series. Empty uses the default one.

parameter.name: role
parameter.label: Price Role
parameter.description: What the resulting series is, which is how the price plane knows where to use it.

options.option: Price paid for energy delivered to the grid

parameter.name: currency
parameter.label: Currency
parameter.description: The three-letter code the raw numbers are in. There is no default: an item carries a number and says nothing about its denomination, and a guessed one reaches you as a price you are about to act on. Cents are not a currency and cannot be used here; carry the price in whole units and scale it for display.

parameter.name: energyUnit
parameter.label: Raw Energy Unit
parameter.description: The unit of energy the raw numbers are per.

parameter.name: marketZone
parameter.label: Market Time Zone
parameter.description: The time zone of the market that produced the prices, which is what names their delivery day. It is not your own zone, and it is never inferred from it or from UTC - so there is no default, and nothing is read until you name one. A central-European day runs 23:00 to 23:00 in UTC, and reading it as a UTC day names it a day early.

parameter.name: horizonHours
parameter.label: Horizon
parameter.description: How far ahead to read the series.

parameter.name: pipeline
parameter.label: Adjustment Order
parameter.description: The adjustments to apply, in the order your own bill applies them, for example fee=0.0279, vat=24. There is deliberately no fixed order: value-added tax on a price that already carries a transfer fee is a different number from a fee added afterwards.

parameter.name: vatPercent
parameter.label: VAT
parameter.description: The tax rate to add, as the percentage your bill states.

parameter.name: fixedFee
parameter.label: Fixed Fee
parameter.description: An amount added to every slot, in the currency above per the raw energy unit.

parameter.name: scale
parameter.label: Scale Factor
parameter.description: A plain multiplier, for a source publishing a bare number in a unit nothing can name.

parameter.name: targetEnergyUnit
parameter.label: Effective Energy Unit
parameter.description: The unit of energy the effective prices should be per.

parameter.name: tariffPeriods
parameter.label: Tariff Periods
parameter.description: Conditional tariff windows, written id;months;days;from;to;amount, for example winter-day;DEC,JAN,FEB;MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT;07:00;22:00;0.06. Leave months or days empty for any. The times are read in your own zone, not the market's.

parameter.name: tariffDefault
parameter.label: Tariff Outside Every Period
parameter.description: What the tariff adds where no period applies.
